title: Xiaomi Mi Box 3 (model MIBOX3, codename once, Amlogic), Android TV 9 (SDK 28), firmware PI.3934, 2 GB RAM,
header:
Xiaomi Mi Box 3 (model MIBOX3, codename once, Amlogic), Android TV 9 (SDK 28), firmware PI.3934, 2 GB RAM,
1920x1080. Streaming box, no HDMI-in or tuner.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<box ip> tools/disable.sh examples/xiaomi-mi-box-3/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<box ip> tools/restore.sh examples/xiaomi-mi-box-3/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Set live_tv_package empty in config.xml (nothing to switch to). Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher
(the scripts' default).

Notes from this box:
- Kept: com.google.android.apps.mediashell (Chromecast), com.xiaomi.mitv.updateservice and its download helper
com.mitv.download.service (firmware updates), com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith (it owned one of the
saved Wi-Fi networks), com.xiaomi.android.tvsetup.partnercustomizer, mitv.service, com.droidlogic*.
- USB debugging alone opens network ADB on port 5555 (service.adb.tcp.port=5555).
- cmd package set-home-activity needs the component on Android 9 (com.gathin.tvhome/.MainActivity), and
dumpsys activity activities shows mResumedActivity, not mFocusedApp.
- Re-enabled at every boot: com.google.android.backdrop (Ambient screensaver). Harmless once the screensaver
points at the launcher's clock, so it is commented out below:
tools/tv.py 'settings put secure screensaver_components com.gathin.tvhome/.ClockDream'
(stock value here: com.android.dreams.basic/com.android.dreams.basic.Colors)
- Remote: Home and Back work with the new launcher without any key service.
- Everything else stayed disabled after a reboot, and the launcher stayed Home.
